context: 3090 Ti uses sm_86 (Ampere); 1080 Ti uses sm_61 (Pascal). SGLang primary build targets sm_86; legacy_helper requires a separate sm_61 build or fall back to llama.cpp.
rationale_for_two_builds: SGLang upstream dropped sm_61 support in v0.3+; building for sm_61 requires patching
llama.cpp b10012-cuda12.4 already supports sm_61 on 1080 Ti (verified 123.5 t/s)
Decision: keep llama.cpp for 1080 Ti (legacy_helper), SGLang for 3090 Ti (primary)

primary_build_target.kernel_patch: flashinfer JIT patch required for sm_86 (drop after build succeeds)
primary_build_target.build_command_intent: git clone https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang.git && cd sglang && git apply <sm86-flashinfer-jit.patch> && pip install -e .

legacy_helper_build_target.next_action: Wire llama-server (sm_61) into pheno-serve as legacy_helper lane on port 18081

decision_record: Single-binary-per-GPU strategy: SGLang on 3090 Ti, llama.cpp on 1080 Ti. Avoids the sm_61 SGLang patch burden and uses already-verified llama.cpp CUDA12.4 build.
next_action: Wire llama-server (sm_61) into pheno-serve config as legacy_helper lane
